commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Register enum literals for parsing data-tiling hint op types (#24711)

The CLI option that lists op families eligible for data-tiling
annotation takes `EncodingOpType` enum values, but no `cl::values` were
registered for it. Hence, passing a keyword such as `convolution` on the
command line to
`--iree-dispatch-creation-experimental-set-data-tiling-ops` failed to
parse. Register the literals (`matmul`, `scaled_matmul`, `convolution`)
so the option is actually usable from `iree-compile`.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup_metadata

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

Co-Authored-by: Jelle Schuhmacher [schuehmacher@roofline.ai](mailto:schuehmacher@roofline.ai)
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) [noreply@anthropic.com](mailto:noreply@anthropic.com)
Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Register enum literals for parsing data-tiling hint op types (#24711)

The CLI option that lists op families eligible for data-tiling
annotation takes `EncodingOpType` enum values, but no `cl::values` were
registered for it. Hence, passing a keyword such as `convolution` on the
command line to
`--iree-dispatch-creation-experimental-set-data-tiling-ops` failed to
parse. Register the literals (`matmul`, `scaled_matmul`, `convolution`)
so the option is actually usable from `iree-compile`.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@4641f4879e47 (#24713)

Integrates LLVM from abbcebe652841d to 4641f4879e47

IREE changes:
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#209424, which changed
`llvm::OptimizationLevel` from a class to an enum.
- Changed `DispatchCreationOptions` in
compiler/src/iree/compiler/Pipelines/Options.h so that `optLevel` is
explicitly initialized to `llvm::OptimizationLevel::O2`. This was the
default value of the old `llvm::OptimizationLevel` class.
- As a side note `CodegenPipelineOptLevel` in
‎compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/Utils/CodegenOptions.h was intended
as a bridge from the old llvm class. Now, that enum seems to duplicate
the new llvm enum, but I did not remove it.
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#204707, which changed
LLVM::FunctionEntryCountAttr while LLVMFuncOp::build in
llvm-project/mlir/lib/Dialect/LLVMIR/IR/LLVMDialect.cpp still expects
`std::optional<uint64_t>`

The integrate caused the following failing tests, that got addressed
with the cherry-picked changes below
```
  The following tests FAILED:
        1750 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1756 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1812 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1818 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
``` 
Additional LLVM fixups:
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/210303
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/209345

commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Register enum literals for parsing data-tiling hint op types (#24711)

The CLI option that lists op families eligible for data-tiling
annotation takes `EncodingOpType` enum values, but no `cl::values` were
registered for it. Hence, passing a keyword such as `convolution` on the
command line to
`--iree-dispatch-creation-experimental-set-data-tiling-ops` failed to
parse. Register the literals (`matmul`, `scaled_matmul`, `convolution`)
so the option is actually usable from `iree-compile`.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: issue-greeter

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Register enum literals for parsing data-tiling hint op types (#24711)

The CLI option that lists op families eligible for data-tiling
annotation takes `EncodingOpType` enum values, but no `cl::values` were
registered for it. Hence, passing a keyword such as `convolution` on the
command line to
`--iree-dispatch-creation-experimental-set-data-tiling-ops` failed to
parse. Register the literals (`matmul`, `scaled_matmul`, `convolution`)
so the option is actually usable from `iree-compile`.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: publish_website

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Register enum literals for parsing data-tiling hint op types (#24711)

The CLI option that lists op families eligible for data-tiling
annotation takes `EncodingOpType` enum values, but no `cl::values` were
registered for it. Hence, passing a keyword such as `convolution` on the
command line to
`--iree-dispatch-creation-experimental-set-data-tiling-ops` failed to
parse. Register the literals (`matmul`, `scaled_matmul`, `convolution`)
so the option is actually usable from `iree-compile`.

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: macos_x64_clang

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@4641f4879e47 (#24713)

Integrates LLVM from abbcebe652841d to 4641f4879e47

IREE changes:
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#209424, which changed
`llvm::OptimizationLevel` from a class to an enum.
- Changed `DispatchCreationOptions` in
compiler/src/iree/compiler/Pipelines/Options.h so that `optLevel` is
explicitly initialized to `llvm::OptimizationLevel::O2`. This was the
default value of the old `llvm::OptimizationLevel` class.
- As a side note `CodegenPipelineOptLevel` in
‎compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/Utils/CodegenOptions.h was intended
as a bridge from the old llvm class. Now, that enum seems to duplicate
the new llvm enum, but I did not remove it.
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#204707, which changed
LLVM::FunctionEntryCountAttr while LLVMFuncOp::build in
llvm-project/mlir/lib/Dialect/LLVMIR/IR/LLVMDialect.cpp still expects
`std::optional<uint64_t>`

The integrate caused the following failing tests, that got addressed
with the cherry-picked changes below
```
  The following tests FAILED:
        1750 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1756 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1812 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1818 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
``` 
Additional LLVM fixups:
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/210303
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/209345

---------

commit_message:
[StableHLO] Handle scatter batching dims and dynamic-update-slice scatters

JAX-emitted scatters use two forms that IREE's StableHLO scatter
preprocessing did not support, causing malformed tensor.expand_shape
crashes during input conversion:

- Scatter batching dims (from vmap(scatter)) were only passed through,
  so the downstream canonicalizers collapsed batching dims together with
  the real scatter loop dim and miscompiled. Add ScatterBatchingDimsExpander
  (benefit 2), ported from upstream StableHLO's ScatterWithBatchingDimsExpander,
  which lowers each batching dim to an explicit iota index column so no
  batching dims remain for the existing patterns.

- Single-index, full-rank overwrite scatters are dynamic-update-slice
  semantics and cannot be represented as iree_linalg_ext.scatter. Add
  ScatterToDynamicUpdateSlice (benefit 3) to rewrite them into
  stablehlo.dynamic_update_slice.

Both patterns run before the existing scatter canonicalizers. Adds lit
tests @scatter_batching_dims and @scatter_to_dynamic_update_slice.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: pr-greeter

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

Co-Authored-by: Jelle Schuhmacher <schuehmacher@roofline.ai>
Assisted-by: Claude-code
Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

Assisted-by: Claude-code

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@4641f4879e47 (#24713)

Integrates LLVM from abbcebe652841d to 4641f4879e47

IREE changes:
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#209424, which changed
`llvm::OptimizationLevel` from a class to an enum.
- Changed `DispatchCreationOptions` in
compiler/src/iree/compiler/Pipelines/Options.h so that `optLevel` is
explicitly initialized to `llvm::OptimizationLevel::O2`. This was the
default value of the old `llvm::OptimizationLevel` class.
- As a side note `CodegenPipelineOptLevel` in
‎compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/Utils/CodegenOptions.h was intended
as a bridge from the old llvm class. Now, that enum seems to duplicate
the new llvm enum, but I did not remove it.
- Adapted to llvm/llvm-project#204707, which changed
LLVM::FunctionEntryCountAttr while LLVMFuncOp::build in
llvm-project/mlir/lib/Dialect/LLVMIR/IR/LLVMDialect.cpp still expects
`std::optional<uint64_t>`

The integrate caused the following failing tests, that got addressed
with the cherry-picked changes below
```
  The following tests FAILED:
        1750 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1756 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1812 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_f16_f16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
        1818 - iree/tests/e2e/matmul/e2e_matmul_cpu_experimental_dt_uk_bf16_bf16_llvm-cpu_local-task_avx2 (SEGFAULT) cpu_features=avx2 driver=local-task iree/tests/e2e/matmul noriscv nowasm
``` 
Additional LLVM fixups:
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/210303
- Cherry-picked https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/209345

Teaches LLVMCPU KernelDispatch to recognize data-tiled convolution dispatches
produced by encoding materialization and  assigns thema dedicated root lowering
that vectorizes OW, oc_inner, ic_inner, and distributes N, OC, OH dimensions
with peeling enabled.

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

Co-Authored-by: Jelle Schuhmacher <schuehmacher@roofline.ai>
Assisted-by: Claude-code
Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

commit_message:
feat: materialize encoding info for convolution with NCHWc layout

Implements convolution encoding materialization for data-tiled layouts.

Layouts:
- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.

---

Co-Authored-by: Jelle Schuhmacher <schuehmacher@roofline.ai>
Assisted-by: Claude-code
Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>

- Input:  [N, IC/c0, H, W, c0]
- Filter: [OC/k0, IC/c0, FH, FW, c0, k0]
- Output: [N, OC/k0, OH, OW, k0]

Scope:

- 2D convolutions only.
- Supports packed rank-5 input/output and rank-6 filter tensors. Rank-4 input/output is also accepted when `N=1` batch dimension has been folded by upstream passes.
- Currently supports floating point convolutions only.

Supported input forms:
- nhwc_hwcf
- nchw_fchw
- nhwc_fhwc

All are materialized to the same packed NCHWc layout above.

Architecture-specific inner tiles:

| Architecture | Condition         | Inner tile (OC, IC) | Target ISA      |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| x86-64       | float, `+avx512f` | `{16,16}`           | `VFMADD*` (zmm) |
| arm64        | float             | `{8,8}`             | `FMLA` (NEON)   |

All other configurations materialize to the identity layout.
